system.description:
You prepare elixirs to be consumed or administered. Crafting one of these concoctions requires a Spellcast Roll (10) as a Downtime action, which consumes 1 Handful and remains potent for a week unless otherwise specified.

  • Red Thirst. A blood-thick draught. For the rest of the scene, all Horrors are drawn to the drinker with a murderous rage and must mark a Stress to try harm someone else.
  • Dead Man’s Blood. A vial of undead and human blood. Inject into an undead creature to render it temporarily Restrained.
  • Ghost Eyes. This bitter tonic clouds the eyes. For one hour, the drinker can clearly see and interact with spirits.
